prompt: Explain the exact bit layout of the VIC-II memory-pointer register $D018 (53272): which bits select the screen (video matrix) base and which select the character generator / bitmap base, and what address granularity each uses within the 16K VIC bank.
assertions: Bits 7-4 select the video matrix (screen RAM) base, in units of $0400 (1K) within the VIC bank
Bits 3-1 select the character generator base, in units of $0800 (2K) within the bank
In bitmap mode, bit 3 selects the bitmap base at $0000 or $2000 within the bank (8K granularity)
